sources.title: Logits Explained: The Logits Probability Distribution | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: The output of softmax is a genuine probability distribution over the whole vocabulary. NOTE Two-sentence version: logits are the model's raw opinion, one number per possible token. Softmax converts that raw opinion into a clean probability distribution that sums to 1. // Why it matters Every word a model writes starts as a logit vector.

sources.title: Logit - Learn AI
sources.snippet: This symmetric behavior about the midpoint makes the logit function odd-symmetric: logit (1 minus p) equals the negative of logit (p). The logit function is the inverse of the logistic sigmoid function, which maps a real number x to the probability sigma (x) equals one divided by one plus the exponential of negative x.
